title: Kaplansky's Conjectures for Group Rings
exact_target: Let $G$ be a group and $K$ a field. If $G$ is torsion-free, must $K[G]$ have no nontrivial units, no nonzero zero divisors, and no idempotents other than $0$ and $1$; and for arbitrary $G$, must $K[G]$ be directly finite?
